svg.title: Interference changes absorption in the incident medium

cc:Work.dc:title: Interference changes absorption in the incident medium
cc:Work.dc:description: Absorbed power and interference contribution versus height in an absorbing incident medium. The bright band just above the reference plane absorbs more, and the darker band above it absorbs less. Together, the incident medium absorbs 0.158 less power.
